reason: The README clearly describes an MCP integration for publishing HTML documents as shareable links, updating and listing published documents, and exporting them to common document formats; document processing is the primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 通过 SendPage MCP 发布、更新和管理可分享的 HTML 文档，并支持导出为 PNG、PDF 和 DOCX。
summaries.en: Use SendPage MCP to publish, update, and manage shareable HTML documents, with export support for PNG, PDF, and DOCX.

capabilities: Publishes HTML documents to an external SendPage service and returns shareable links
Updates the contents or title of previously published documents
Lists documents published with the configured API key and their view counts
Exports published documents to PNG, PDF, and DOCX formats
Uses bearer API-key authentication over Streamable HTTP
